description: This Python source file defines the AgentAI class, which provides a comprehensive interface for integrating large language models (LLMs) and multimodal capabilities such as text, image, audio, and video processing within an agent context. The class includes methods for AI interactions, multimodal inputs/outputs, image generation, speech synthesis, video creation, and audio transcription, supporting lazy loading of heavy libraries and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: AgentAI
classes.description: A utility class that encapsulates AI/LLM integration functionalities for an agent, supporting multimodal inputs and outputs, lazy loading of dependencies, fallback mechanisms, and advanced prompt management.
